title: Enable Add New Staff Member option for Admin and Manager roles

requirements.text: Update the StaffManagement component to enable the 'Add New Staff Member' button for users with Admin (Owner) role in addition to the existing Manager role access

quotes: admin level and manager level add a new staff member option available

acceptanceCriteria: Users with Owner role can see and click the 'Add New Staff Member' button
Users with Manager role can see and click the 'Add New Staff Member' button
Users with Operator and Attendant roles cannot see or access the 'Add New Staff Member' button
The button functionality works correctly for both Owner and Manager roles

requirements.text: Update backend access control in the addStaffMember function to allow both Owner and Manager roles to add new staff members

quotes: admin level and manager level add a new staff member option available

acceptanceCriteria: The addStaffMember function accepts requests from users with Owner role
The addStaffMember function accepts requests from users with Manager role
The addStaffMember function rejects requests from users with Operator or Attendant roles
Appropriate error messages are returned when unauthorized users attempt to add staff

constraints: Do not modify the Internet Identity authentication flow
Maintain the existing UI component structure in StaffManagement
Preserve all existing role-based access control patterns for other features
nonGoals: Changing the staff member form fields or validation logic
Modifying other role permissions beyond adding staff members
Adding new roles beyond the existing Owner, Manager, Operator, and Attendant
